mapper.select: SELECT budget_id AS budgetId, target_month AS targetMonth, total_amount AS totalAmount FROM BUDGETS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_month = #{targetMonth}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BUDGETS ( user_id, target_month, total_amount ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{request.targetMonth}, #{request.totalAmount} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_amount = VALUES(total_amount), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
